text:
Marta: Quick design question — the bulk export confirmation modal feels a little scary right now. Current copy: 'Exporting may include sensitive data. Proceed?'. Can we make it clearer and more accessible? @Alex any thoughts?

Alex: Yep, agree. Two problems: 'sensitive data' is vague, and there's no hint about size/time or what exactly is included. Would help to surface estimated size and that we'll email the link.

Sam K: Accessibility note — the dialog should announce as an alert and focus the primary action. Copy-wise: make it explicit about what's included (prompts, responses, attachments).

Divya: Also consider a confirmation checkbox so people actively acknowledge the export may contain customer data. That reduces accidental exports for support cases.

Alex: I drafted two short variants:

```
Option A (concise):
'Exporting this workspace will include prompts, responses, and metadata. It may contain customer data. We'll email you when the export is ready.'

Option B (explicit / security):
'This export includes customer prompts, model responses, and attached files. Do not share exported files without approval. Estimated size: ~<calculated>. We'll email a secure download link when it's ready.'
```

Marta: I prefer A for tone but change 'customer data' -> 'sensitive customer data' and add a microcopy link for 'why this might include customer data'.

Sam K: Accessibility nit: avoid link text = 'learn more' alone. Use descriptive link text like 'Why exports may include customer data'. Also ensure checkbox label is explicit for screen readers.

Divya: CTA should not be 'Confirm' — use 'Request export' or 'Start export' so users understand it's asynchronous.

Irene (bot): automated-check: modal has role=dialog (pass). Contrast analyzer flagged the warning icon + body text ratio 2.8:1 (fail). Recommend increasing font-weight or darkening text color.

Marta: Good catch on contrast — we'll update visual treatment.

Alex: Updated copy + structure in Figma, adding checkbox and CTA change. Dropping the proposed final copy here:

```
Heading: 'Export workspace data'
Body: 'This export includes prompts, responses, and metadata from this workspace. It may contain sensitive customer data. We'll prepare the export and email you a secure download link when it's ready.'
Checkbox label: 'I understand this export may include sensitive customer data.'
Primary CTA: 'Request export'    Secondary CTA: 'Cancel'
Help link: 'Why exports may include customer data'
```

Marta: Tiny tone nit: 'We'll prepare the export' reads better than 'We'll process' — softer.

Divya: :thumbsup: Looks good. Also request a short inline hint near the estimated size that explains variability (e.g., 'Size is estimated; final file may be larger').

Alex: Will add the size hint and the a11y copy for the checkbox. Also I'll swap icon color to a darker orange to satisfy contrast.

Sam K: One more thing — for keyboard users, make sure the checkbox is focusable before the primary CTA and that the primary CTA is disabled until checkbox checked (if we require acknowledgement). If we don't require it, consider a subtle guard instead (info icon + tooltip).

Marta: Good point. Let's make it required for workspace-level exports but optional for personal exports. I'll add that rule to the spec for devs.

Alex: Done in Figma. Ping me if you want a quick review before I hand off to engineering.

Marta: Thanks all — I'll consolidate notes and send to @eng for implementation.
